initiative.title: Build your own realm
initiative.body: After the Haunted House, a visitor builds their own realm from one voice prompt: the agent answers with a short board of features, the visitor checks the ones they want, and the realm is made from only those and published without a deploy. The owner decides everything visitors get, and accepts or declines what others propose (Kiki's notes, October 29).

milestones.title: Build your own realm
milestones.body: Prompt, board, make, and you are in your world: desktop and phone.

milestones.title: Build your own realm: what's rough
milestones.body: Follow-ups from the first version (October 29): talk, looks, speed, and the paths not yet tested.

milestones.title: Every realm edits the same way
milestones.body: Editing any realm on any planet works like Build your own realm: the design board from a voice prompt, the owner's settings pane, and accept or decline for others' changes (owner, October 29).

tasks.title: A typed planner turns a spoken prompt into a feature board
tasks.body: POST /api/playtest/realms/plan {prompt, board?}: Gemini on Vertex AI with a response schema of a fixed catalogue of what the made-realm engine draws today (ground, time of day, style, water, trees, rocks, plants, lanterns, a flock, props, characters with names and roles, and the visitor tools). The server holds the answer to the catalogue; nothing matches the prompt's words. Talking again revises the board.
acceptance: An answer outside the catalogue is held to it or refused (API tests with a fake model)
A production smoke with the real model returns a board for a spoken-style prompt

tasks.title: /realms/new: hold to talk, the board, check features on or off, MAKE IT
tasks.body: A Coaxial page: one HOLD TO TALK button (the microphone only while held, the voice host's speech to text), typing as the fallback, the board as a short list with a checkbox each, talk again to revise, one button to make it.
acceptance: The board is legible on a 390 px phone and on a desktop (headless shots)
coax test builder.coax passes

tasks.title: Make the realm from only the checked features, live at /realms/<slug> with no deploy
tasks.body: POST /api/playtest/realms: the checked board becomes a realm owned by the visitor's player key (and account when logged in; a guest claims it by logging in), its page written into the site's bucket, kept through staging deploys and releases.
acceptance: API tests: owner, slug, page written to the bucket
A made realm opens at /realms/<slug> on production

tasks.title: The made realm: empty but for what was checked; characters only if checked
tasks.body: A realm module (myrealm.coax) that reads the realm's spec from the server and draws its ground, sky, water, trees, rocks, lanterns, flock, props and characters, with the visitor tools the owner allows.
acceptance: coax test myrealm.coax passes
A realm without characters has none; one with them has only those

tasks.title: The owner's settings pane: which tools visitors get, checked on the server
tasks.body: Owner only, from one SETTINGS pane (the panes rule: only that pane): build, fly, jump, map, talk, voice. The server refuses anyone else's change.
acceptance: A non-owner's settings change is a 403 (API test)
A tool switched off is gone for visitors

tasks.title: Others' changes reach the owner as ACCEPT or DECLINE cards
tasks.body: A visitor who builds in someone else's realm proposes the change; the owner sees each one as a card with what it was before and after, and ACCEPT or DECLINE. Nothing changes the realm until the owner accepts.
acceptance: API tests: a proposal waits, accept places it, decline doesn't, only the owner decides

tasks.title: The Haunted House moves you on to Build your own realm
tasks.body: When the Haunted House's quest is complete, BUILD YOUR OWN REALM takes the visitor to /realms/new.
acceptance: The button shows only after the quest is complete and goes to /realms/new

tasks.title: Analytics for each step: prompt, board, toggles, made, entered
tasks.body: builder-prompt, builder-board, builder-toggle, builder-make, realm-made and world-enter in the made realm, sent as every page's events are; team and admins are marked as the analytics contract says and never counted.
acceptance: The events reach /api/analytics/events in a headless run

tasks.title: Characters in a made realm talk, and the voice tool works
tasks.body: Today a made realm's characters show only their name and role, and the talk and voice settings do nothing. Wire them to the character chat and memory Everglade's people use, and the voice tool to push-to-talk, honouring the owner's settings.
acceptance: Pressing E (or tapping) a character in a made realm gets an answer in character
With talk or voice switched off by the owner, visitors don't get it

tasks.title: A made realm looks like its style: painterly realms drawn painterly
tasks.body: Made realms use the fixture pack's meshes with simple sky, ground and water. Draw a painterly board with the painterly presets (verse/style.coax, paint packs, painted sky and water) and a low poly one with the low poly look.
acceptance: A painterly made realm passes the style check
Headless desktop and phone shots of both styles

tasks.title: The flock can be seen from the ground
tasks.body: Bats fly 6 m up and did not show in the staging shot. Bring them down into view and give them a silhouette against the sky.
acceptance: The flock is visible in a headless shot from the arrival point

tasks.title: Lantern posts show on bright ground
tasks.body: Lantern posts barely show on bright grounds. Give them contrast against the ground and a light pool at night.
acceptance: Lanterns are clear in shots on the brightest ground, day and night

tasks.title: The first board comes back in under 5 seconds
tasks.body: The first plan on staging took 20 s (production 4 s); the page waits up to 40 s. Find the cold-start cost (model warm-up, connection, instance) and remove it.
acceptance: Ten first plans after a fresh deploy all answer in under 5 s

tasks.title: Drive the builder by voice end to end
tasks.body: The voice to planner path is covered only by unit tests: smokes skipped it to save the voice host's daily speaker cap. Add a smoke that sends recorded speech through hold-to-talk to a board, with one fixed speaker id.
acceptance: A recorded prompt reaches a board on staging and production

tasks.title: A guest's realm moves to their account when they log in
tasks.body: Ownership relies on login moving a player key's worlds to the account; untested for made realms. Test it and fix what it misses.
acceptance: API test: a guest makes a realm, logs in, and owns it as the account (settings and accept or decline work)

tasks.title: Fairy Forest's WGSL carries its style block (realms.test.ts passes)
tasks.body: coax/web/realms.test.ts fails: "fairy-forest is drawn painterly but fairy.wgsl has no style block". Splice verse/style.coax into fairy.wgsl with coax/web/wgsl.py --into, or lift fairy's paint.coax into the shared presets.
acceptance: bun test coax/web/realms.test.ts passes

tasks.title: One edit layer every realm loads
tasks.body: Lift the builder's board, settings pane and proposal cards out of myrealm.coax into a shared module (verse/edit/*.coax plus one face hook) that any realm page loads. Owners and admins of a realm get EDIT; the board describes the realm as it is now (its features and pieces), and talking revises it: check a feature on or off and the realm changes.
acceptance: A hand-built realm and a made realm both open the same edit layer
coax tests for the shared module

tasks.title: Owners for every realm, not only made ones
tasks.body: Every realm in realms.json has an owner (account) and admins; the server decides who may edit, settle proposals and change settings for any realm slug.
acceptance: API tests: owner and admin may, others get 403, for a hand-built realm slug

tasks.title: Everglade edits through the shared layer
tasks.body: Everglade's edit mode and voice edits move onto the shared layer: board, settings, proposals. Voice edits keep working.
acceptance: An admin revises Everglade from the board; a visitor's change arrives as a card

tasks.title: Every other realm gets the shared edit layer
tasks.body: Hecate's Cemetery, the Grid, Fairy Forest, Dead Gears, Ice Cream Man, the Haunted House and made realms all load it (replaces grid-edit and hc-edit).
acceptance: Each realm shows EDIT to its owner and admins in a headless run

tasks.title: TALK on /realms/new is a toggle, not hold to talk
tasks.body: Owner, October 29: tap TALK (or Space) to start, the button says LISTENING with the words as they're heard, tap again to send. A quiet spell after words sends; nothing heard closes the microphone. The microphone is open only while TALK is on. TYPE IT stays; other realms keep push to talk.
acceptance: coax test apps/openagents-web/builder.coax: the toggle, Space, the quiet spell and nothing-heard checks pass
Production /realms/new shows TALK and the tap hint

tasks.title: Setup questions before the board, and the cameras the made realm honours
tasks.body: Owner, October 29: guide the visitor through 2D or 3D, the camera (third person, first person, top-down; second person isn't a game camera), the art style, the ground and the time of day, one at a time, each a tap or SAY IT or SKIP. The answers are the planner's fixed fields; CHANGE on the board goes through them again. The made realm draws each camera: third, first person at eye height with no figure and drag look, top-down at a fixed angle, and 2D side-on with an orthographic camera, a lane and jump.
acceptance: coax/web/api/test.sh passes the setup and pick checks
coax test builder.coax and myrealm.coax pass the setup and camera checks
A first-person and a top-down realm made on staging draw their cameras

tasks.title: Top-down: your figure reads as a figure, not a thin line
tasks.body: From high above the figure is a thin line. Scale or tilt the top-down camera, or give the figure a readable top silhouette and a ground ring.
acceptance: Headless top-down shot shows a clear figure on desktop and phone

tasks.title: 2D: rocks and trees block you; you jump onto them
tasks.body: In 2D you walk through rocks and trees. Give them colliders in the lane and let you jump onto them.
acceptance: A 2D run stops at a rock and can jump onto it

tasks.title: First person on phones: a thumb drag looks up and down
tasks.body: Touch drag turns but cannot pitch; the mouse can.
acceptance: A 390 px headless drag changes pitch
